text:
Sam: Morning — quick standup.
Sam: Did: rolled KV eviction tweak (canary to eu-west), ran synthetic embed latency test, tuned batcher alert thresholds.
Sam: Blockers: seeing intermittent 504s when batcher queue > ~6k, logs have noisy 'kv-miss' spikes and it's unclear if autoscaler or warmup is the culprit. Need correlation help.
Sam: Today: dig into batcher backlog root cause, post PR for autoscaler guardrail, update runbook for eviction-related alerts.

Kai: Nice summary. Can you paste the canary deploy id and the exact alert that fired?

Sam: deploy-bot: canary v2.3.1 [canary-id: canary-20240318-17]
Sam: Alert: batcher_5xx_rate > 1% for 5m -> fired 03:14 UTC, auto-resolved after 21m.
Sam: Logs linked: /infra/logs/canary-20240318-17 and traces: https://tracing.internal/trace/abc123

Rhea: I pulled the traces — pod startup lag ~28-35s due to quantized weight pull on first pod. Suggest pre-pull or small warm pool to avoid scale cold starts.

Devon: pinging on the autoscaler PR review. Left comments about race condition when inflight requests spike during scaling.

Sam: @Devon thanks — I'll address the race condition edge-case (wrap inflight counter with the pending-scaling lock).

Kai: FYI the SLO alert was noisy because we aggregated by route; we should try grouping by model shard to reduce blast radius. I'll prototype a filter.

Rhea: I'll take on the oncall follow-up and start a short postmortem draft. Assigning to myself for initial notes.

ops-bot: Incident {INC-20240318-77} created: Batcher 504 spike. Assigned: Rhea. Priority: P2.

Sam: Quick metric note: added eviction_rate_5m gauge to the ops dashboard and a heatmap for pod startup durations.

Devon: Reviewed the PR, one inline request about double-decrement of the inflight counter. lgtm after fix.

Sam: Merged autoscaler guardrail PR and extended canary window another 30m. Monitoring watch set. Will post EOD update. :thumbsup:

Rhea: I'll add runbook step to prewarm quantized weights and include the new dashboard links. Will post link to doc here when ready.

Kai: If you want I can run k8s event correlation query and share results.

Sam: Appreciate it — please do, @Kai. I'll follow up with logs + flamegraphs.

Rhea: Drafted postmortem skeleton, adding timeline now. Will post for review in ~45m.

Sam: thanks team — closing loop for now, will update if anything changes.
